CREATE VIEW args_view AS select A.argset, V2.data as keyName, A.id, D.desc, (case when A.datatype==1 then V.data else A.value end) as strValue from args as A left join data_type as D on (D.typeId = A.datatype) left join data_dict as V on V.id = A.value left join data_dict as V2 on V2.id = A.key

CREATE VIEW args_view AS select A.argset, V2.data as keyName, A.id, D.desc, (case when A.datatype==1 then V.data else A.value end) as strValue from args as A left join data_type as D on (D.typeId = A.datatype) left join data_dict as V on V.id = A.value left join data_dict as V2 on V2.id = A.key
